title: Flashback: the Khan's gold tablet
place: The court of Kublai Khan, 1266, a generic Mongol palace hall (Polo, Prologue ch. 2-8: the brothers' first journey).

accuracy.source: Marco Polo, Travels, Yule-Cordier ed. (Project Gutenberg #10636); Claude with ChatGPT (text only), 2026-11-26
findings: Polo: Kublai gave them 'a Tablet of Gold' ordering horses and escorts on the way (Prologue ch. 8).
Surviving tablets: long plates with rounded ends and a hole at the top. Phags-pa script came only in 1269, so a 1266 tablet carries vertical Uyghur-Mongol script.
Kublai: 'neither tall nor short', 'complexion white and red, the eyes black'.
Dadu was not built until 1267: keep the hall generic.

layout.status: Draft blocking for the storyboard (Nov 26 2026); distances are a first proposal.

approved.how: standing approval, 23:25: "can you just not wait for my approval every time, and continue making all the storyboards that we need?"

layout.light: warm daylight from tall doors on the south side (bottom of the map)

landmarks.label: the Khan's raised throne
landmarks.note: on a low dais at the north end of the hall

camera.framing: Wide, from the doors, eye level

cells.action: Down the long hall, Niccolò and Maffeo kneel before Kublai Khan on his raised throne; courtiers line both sides.

where.niccolo: the kneeling man on the left
where.maffeo: the kneeling man on the right
where.kublai: the seated ruler on the throne at the far end

cells.action: Kublai Khan leans forward on his throne, curious about these two Latin merchants.
A courtier lays a gold tablet in Niccolò's open hands; Maffeo kneels beside him, watching.

where.niccolo: the man receiving the tablet, on the right
where.maffeo: the man on the left, beside him

cells.action: The gold tablet in Niccolò's hands: a long gold plate with rounded ends, a hole at the top for its cord, engraved with vertical Uyghur-Mongol script; no animal on it.
